description: Central Cultural Fund v. P. Danansuriya, Arbitrator of the Department of Labour and Others Central Cultural Fund v. P. Danansuriya, Arbitrator of the Department of Labour and Others View More before Hon. Upaly Abeyrathne, J.
parties: Central Cultural Fund v. P. Danansuriya, Arbitrator of the Department of Labour and Others Central Cultural Fund v. P. Danansuriya, Arbitrator of the Department of Labour and Others View More
keywords: The Petitioner sought to quash the arbitral award of certain sum as acting salary to the post of \'Officer in charge\' payable to the 4th Respondent, who was also holding the substantive post of \'Excavating Officer Grade I\'. Entitlement to acting salary only if an officer holding substantive post is appointed to act in another post as well. Held - no \'Officer in charge\' post existed in the Petitioner\'s cadre. Writ issued with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
